executionGate: Do not execute until the parent supplies the published source commit and both saved-result locations.

method.inputPins: Read config, analyzer and protocol from the supplied immutable Git commit; verify source-input hashes and private-evidence hash before parsing values.
method.baseline: Parse decimal source values independently, sort static records numerically by RPM, and bisect the sorted values around 15030; require original row IDs 13 and 14 and the frozen anchor values.
method.interpolation: Use Decimal arithmetic for the interpolation weight and baseline coefficient; retain lower and higher anchor scenarios separately.
method.positiveCubic: For alpha>0 use the hyperbolic solution x=2 sqrt(alpha/3) sinh(asinh(3 sqrt(3)/(2 alpha^(3/2)))/3), evaluated with logarithmic and small-argument branches. Use x=1 at alpha=0. Recompute the cubic residual independently.
method.predictions: Recompute alpha, root and CT prediction separately for every scenario and every one of the fourteen rows, for 42 predictions total.
method.metrics: Recompute full-run and strict reported-CT-positive secondary max/RMS, scenario-C0-normalized max/RMS, signed mean, row counts and maximizing IDs. Use Decimal accumulation for residual statistics.
method.branchLabels: Independently derive reported CT>0 membership; preserve and publicly count CT<=0 rows as outside the model's representable positive-thrust branch.
method.savedNumerics: Check all saved alpha/root/prediction/residual values, bisection brackets, residuals, iterations and public numerical summaries without rerunning the bisection solver.

publicationPolicy: Public review output contains hashes, aggregate metrics, aggregate comparison deltas, counts, row-ID labels and pass/fail checks only. No complete raw table, complete per-row derived table, or per-row predictor/residual pairs are emitted.
limits: Nearest static baseline is determined by RPM sorting, not source-file order
Endpoint scenarios recompute alpha and predictions, not just rescaled metrics
No physical adequacy threshold, confidence interval, shaft-power equivalence or model-only rejection
No new source acquisition, parameter fitting, additional target rows or physical extensions
